thread:
lina_m: Received DSAR (EU) for full erasure. User requests embeddings + chat timeline. Found an orphaned snapshot (snap-orphan-42) referencing a missing KMS key version. Legal also flagged a temporary retention exception for an audit (hold ID AUD-042). Need a safe plan — do not delete while hold active.
raj_patel: Important: orphaned snapshot will block verification. We need chain-of-custody + reproducible proof of attempted deletion. Also check if this user appears in any active vuln triage/incident tickets.
olivia: Quick inventory: user has snap-eu-42 (good key), snap-us-42 (mirror), and snap-orphan-42 (missing key version). The keystore metadata shows key `projects/redwood/locations/eu-west1/key-legacy` with version `v0` which no longer exists.
marco_ops: Two paths: 1) request keystore-admin to restore key version via key rotation backfill (requires compliance sign-off), or 2) extract ciphertext bundle and perform a rewrap-to-ephemeral via keystore-admin adhoc decrypt+encrypt for proof. Both need timebound RBAC and audit entries.
keystore-admin: I can perform forced rewrap but we must record explicit approvers. I won't grant broad perms. Propose creating role `temp:custodian:AUD-042` with `cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on ephemeral key only, 1h TTL. Approvers: @raj_patel + @olivia.
raj_patel: Approved. infra principal will be `serviceAccount:marco-ops@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. infra, please include audit label `reason=DSAR-AUD-042 orphan-unwrap` and capture pre/post S3 listings.
marco_ops: Granting now, will paste audit link. Command preview:
```
# create ephemeral HSM key
gcloud kms keys create ephemeral-aud-042 --location=eu-west1 --keyring=ephemeral-rg
# bind minimal IAM
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/eu-west1/ephemeral-aud-042 --member=serviceAccount:marco-ops@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
# rewrap orphan snapshot (admin-assisted)
keystore admin-rewrap --snapshot=snap-orphan-42 --to-key=projects/redwood/locations/eu-west1/ephemeral-aud-042 --note="DSAR AUD-042"
keystore verify --snapshot=snap-orphan-42 --proof-out=aud-042-orphan-proof.json
aws s3 cp aud-042-orphan-proof.json s3://priv-proofs/AUD-042/
```
keystore-admin: Running admin-rewrap now, will not expose key material. All actions logged to /audit/logs.
marco_ops: Admin rewrap completed, verification passed, proof stored at s3://priv-proofs/AUD-042/aud-042-orphan-proof.json. Audit entry: https://audit.internal/entries/AUD-042-xyz :lock:
lina_m: Verified proof and shared with Legal. Snapshot metadata marked `hold:AUD-042`. No deletion performed while hold active.
legal-team: Received artifacts. Hold remains until audit clears. Please open retention-exception ticket PRIV-AUD-042 for Finance reconciliation.
raj_patel: Follow-up actions: 1) add orphan-snapshot detection to retention runbook 2) automate temp-custodian role creation + signed-proof schema (key fingerprint, KMS key version, signature, timestamp) 3) postmortem if admin rewrap needed.
security-bot: Vault: AUD-042 artifacts and audit entries saved.
